reterminalLayout.name: reTerminal
reterminalLayout.description: Made for the Seeed reTerminal E1001, E1002, E1003 and E1004. A status bar beside the keys shows the signal, the battery and when the picture was drawn. Under each key it says what a hold does. The bar changes only when the scene draws. Double-press the green key for the scene list, which shows how to move through it. On the touch E1003 the bar is also buttons.
